title: HLSE Protect Verdict
description: JSON output of `hlse_core --json protect <path> [--ransomware|--smb|--mbr|--net]` — ransomware, SMB canary, MBR/GPT, and network-drive integrity checks.

hlse_version.description: HLSE engine version that produced this verdict. Use this field to identify verdicts that predate a new detector capability and should be re-scanned.

reasons.description: Per-signal detector reasons (ransomware entropy, SMB canary access, mass rename, MBR/GPT anomaly). Empty array for SAFE verdicts.

blind_spot.description: What HLSE cannot detect for ransomware/integrity scanning (score 0 only).

signal_count.description: Number of independent detector reasons that fired (score > 0 only).

pattern.description: Attack pattern label (score >= 40 — ALERT band and above).

pattern_id.description: Stable SIEM/SOAR routing token (present iff pattern is present).

objective.description: The attacker's likely objective (score >= 40 — ALERT band and above).

verify.description: Independent check before taking action, e.g. before paying a ransom (score >= 40 — ALERT band and above).

triage.description: Immediate incident response — disconnect network, preserve evidence (score >= 60 only).

cascade_risk.description: Other credentials and network shares at risk (score >= 60 only).

exoneration.description: Benign explanation and falsifying test for borderline scores (score 15-59 only).
